blurb: Leavitt Meadows Pack Station offers scenic horseback rides of 1, 2, or 4 hours suitable for beginners and experienced riders. They provide backcountry support by transporting guests and gear via horseback and mule to wilderness destinations. They also offer pack delivery services to assist hikers by carrying gear to chosen destinations.
